subject: planner: fix the issue that the optimizer cannot convert OUTER JOIN to INNER JOIN with nested AND/OR in some cases (#49625)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. Change adds a targeted null-rejection special case to help `simplifyOuterJoin` recognize predicates of the form `X OR (Y AND ...)` where `X` and at least one conjunct `Y` are null-rejected w.r.t. the inner-table schema (a sound sufficient condition that the whole OR cannot be TRUE under inner-side NULL-extension). Also adds an integration test reproducing #49616 by asserting the expected `IndexJoin` plan for a previously-missed LEFT JOIN elimination case. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL-semantics, or session/transaction-behavior issues found in the added logic within planner scope.
